tips.title: 用一句中文说清这个 skill 能帮你做什么
tips.detail: 把这个文件复制到 ~/.claude/claude-tips/tips.local.json，再换成你自己的 skill。这个文件只在你的电脑上，不会进仓库。

en.title: Say in one line what this skill does for you
en.detail: Optional: the English view shows these two lines. Leave out "en" and that view shows the Chinese text instead.
